label: MIC4576 (TO220)
description:
MIC4576 3A 200KHz 24V Buck DC to DC converter in TO220 package.


The MIC4576 improves on the LM2576 by increasing the switching frequency to 200Khz, allowing the use of smaller inductors and capacitors. It is pin-compatible.
